about: Renders a track a person switches on and off, and the text that names it. A press anywhere on the row toggles the switch.

align.about: The track's position against a label that wraps: on the first line, or halfway down the text.
align.title: Alignment

devices: Applies to every device you sign in on.

field.about: A switch inside a field takes the field's disabled, invalid, read-only and required states and size, and its input lists the field's texts in `aria-describedby`.
field.title: In a field

group.about: Switches inside a fieldset take the group's size and disabled state. Each row takes the group's width and puts its track at the far end.
group.title: In a fieldset

long: Keep me signed in on this device until I sign out, even after the browser is closed

palette.about: Every palette in every look. The palette fills a checked track.
palette.title: Palettes

radius.about: Every corner. The thumb takes the track's corner.
radius.title: Corners

spread.about: A row at its own width, and a settings row that takes the width it is given with the track at the far end.
spread.title: Spread

states.about: Off, on, invalid and disabled, in every look. The off thumb takes the edge color, so it turns the error color on an invalid switch.
states.title: States

status.about: Every status in every look. A status sets the edge, the off thumb and the fill, and overrides the palette.
status.title: Statuses

title: Switch

variant.about: Every look at every size, each checked so the fill shows.
variant.title: Looks and sizes
